items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: And Miles Davis either. All them fellows, they all came up there after I left.

ctx.x: Oh yes. What about Buddy Anderson with Jay McShann? Was he anything like in Dizzy's league?
I didn't know much about him. No, I didn't know much about him. And Miles Davis either. All them fellows, they all came up there after I left.
So after you finished with Snub, which was what...? About a year?
